set.body: The public Mvpa.run path for leave-one-run-out validation rejects GeneralizationAxis(run, ...) with ScientificSpecificationError.UnknownDesignAxis(run) because CategoricalObservationSource exposes sample and neural axes but not the identified run grouping evidence. Existing executable tests use the sample axis name, which makes the schedule numerically correct while the plan receipt cannot state what it generalizes over. Design an identified grouping-column/source-axis representation; bind ValidationDesign to that exact evidence; prove run-label reorder/rename laws; migrate examples; and delete the sample-axis workaround. Do not weaken ScientificSpecification axis validation.
set.title: Predictive MVPA cannot bind a truthful run generalization axis
